pre claude-code [ -x '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/bin/pregate' ] && [ -s '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/bin/pregate' ] && exec '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/bin/pregate' hook pre --harness claude-code; exec /bin/sh -c "$(printf '%b' 'PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:\044PATH; consented() { d=\044(cd "\044{1}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1; while [ "\044{d#/}" != "\044d" ]; do unknown=1; g=\044(git -C "\044d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "\044g" ]; then g=\044(cd "\044g" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ -n "\044g" ] && unknown=; else g=\044d; fi; r=\044(printf '\''%s'\'' "\044d" | sed '\''s/\\\\/\\\\\\\\/g;s/"/\\\\"/g'\''); g=\044(printf '\''%s'\'' "\044g" | sed '\''s/\\\\/\\\\\\\\/g;s/"/\\\\"/g'\''); records=\044(grep -hF "\\"root\\":\\"\044r\\"," '\''/home/user/.local/share/pregate/consent'\''/*.json 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; [ -n "\044records" ] && { [ -n "\044unknown" ] || printf '\''%s'\'' "\044records" | grep -qF "\\"common\\":\\"\044g\\""; } && return 0; reviews=\044(grep -hF "\\"root\\":\\"\044r\\"," '\''/home/user/.local/share/pregate/proposals'\''/*.json 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; [ -n "\044reviews" ] && return 0; [ -e "\044d/.git" ] && return 1; d=\044{d%/*}; done; return 1; }; for d in "\044{CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "\044{CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "\044{GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}" "\044PWD"; do consented "\044d" && { printf '\''%s\\n'\'' '\''PREGATE could not evaluate: its launcher is missing; report it to the user'\'' >&2; exit 2; }; done; exit 0')"
pre codex f='/home/user/.local/share/pregate/bin/pregate'; [ -x "$f" ] && [ -s "$f" ] && exec "$f" hook pre --harness codex; PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH; consented() { d=$(cd "${1}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1; while [ "${d#/}" != "$d" ]; do unknown=1; g=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$g" ]; then g=$(cd "$g" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ -n "$g" ] && unknown=; else g=$d; fi; r=$(printf '%s' "$d" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g;s/"/\\"/g'); g=$(printf '%s' "$g" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g;s/"/\\"/g'); records=$(grep -hF "\"root\":\"$r\"," '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/consent'/*.json 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$records" ] && { [ -n "$unknown" ] || printf '%s' "$records" | grep -qF "\"common\":\"$g\""; } && return 0; reviews=$(grep -hF "\"root\":\"$r\"," '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/proposals'/*.json 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$reviews" ] && return 0; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && return 1; d=${d%/*}; done; return 1; }; for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}" "$PWD"; do consented "$d" && { printf '%s\n' 'PREGATE could not evaluate: its launcher is missing; report it to the user' >&2; exit 2; }; done; exit 0
pre agy f='/home/user/.local/share/pregate/bin/pregate'; [ -x "$f" ] && [ -s "$f" ] && exec "$f" hook pre --harness agy; PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH; consented() { d=$(cd "${1}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || return 1; while [ "${d#/}" != "$d" ]; do unknown=1; g=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$g" ]; then g=$(cd "$g" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ -n "$g" ] && unknown=; else g=$d; fi; r=$(printf '%s' "$d" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g;s/"/\\"/g'); g=$(printf '%s' "$g" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g;s/"/\\"/g'); records=$(grep -hF "\"root\":\"$r\"," '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/consent'/*.json 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$records" ] && { [ -n "$unknown" ] || printf '%s' "$records" | grep -qF "\"common\":\"$g\""; } && return 0; reviews=$(grep -hF "\"root\":\"$r\"," '/home/user/.local/share/pregate/proposals'/*.json 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$reviews" ] && return 0; [ -e "$d/.git" ] && return 1; d=${d%/*}; done; return 1; }; p=$(cat); d=$(printf '%s' "$p" | sed -n 's/.*"workspacePaths":\["\([^"\\]*\)".*/\1/p'); consented "$d" && { printf '%s\n' 'PREGATE could not evaluate: its launcher is missing; report it to the user' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
